notes.title: Simplified Tutorial
notes.notes:
[p]We regularly watch our community boards for player feedback, bugs and general discussions that our players are having about the games we make. After some careful consideration, and a few internal tweaks, we have included a minor update to address the following:
[/p][list][*][p]Simplified Tutorial experience[/p][/*][*][p]Added game play control hints to the Pause Menu[/p][/*][/list][p]
We hope these changes are helpful for the overall experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Happy hashi puzzle solving![/p]

notes.title: Bridge Animation Fix!
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you for those that graciously brought this issue to our attention! We were successfully able to reproduce [i]and fix[/i] the breaking bridge animation graphics issue in this update.
[/p][p]We also snuck in a useful feature for players that want to skip the bridge building animation with a newly added toggle in the Settings menu under Settings>Game>Disable Bridge Animations.[/p][p]
Happy hashi puzzle solving![/p]
